newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Banco Real eyes $300 mln in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Banco Real eyes $300 mln in bonds.

text.p: Brazilian retail bank Banco Real plans to issue $300 million in Eurobonds by the end of the year, director general Rene Aduan said.
Aduan told Reuters that the bonds would carry maturities of three to four years and would be used to finance agriculture and corporate loans.

Banco Real issued a $250 million two-tranche bond in July. The first tranche was a $175 million three-year bond, which priced at 190 basis points over Treasuries. The other, a $75 million four-year bond, came at a spread of 205 bps.
